tools.name: qashier_list_checkout_sessions
tools.description: List online payment Checkout Sessions, newest first, with status (open/complete/expired), payment status, amount in cents, refunds and receipt number. Cursor pagination: pass starting_after with the last id. GET /checkout/sessions.

tools.name: qashier_get_checkout_session
tools.description: Get one Checkout Session by id: status, payment status, payment method, amount in cents, checkout url and refunds. GET /checkout/sessions/{id}.

tools.name: qashier_create_checkout_session
tools.description: WRITE: create a payment Checkout Session for ONE item and return its payment url. It charges nothing until the customer pays at that url. Amount is in cents (SGD 12.50 = 1250). POST /checkout/sessions.

tools.name: qashier_expire_checkout_session
tools.description: WRITE: expire an OPEN Checkout Session so the customer can no longer pay it. It fails if the session is not open. POST /checkout/sessions/{id}/expire.

tools.name: qashier_refund_payment
tools.description: WRITE, MONEY: refund a paid Checkout Session to the customer's original payment method. Omit amount for a full refund; amount is in cents. The refund runs asynchronously (status pending). This call has no idempotency key, so do NOT retry it: check qashier_get_checkout_session first. POST /refund.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: qashier_get_checkout_session, qashier_expire_checkout_session, qashier_refund_payment · Public sink: qashier_create_checkout_session, qashier_expire_checkout_session, qashier_refund_payment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: qashier_get_checkout_session, qashier_expire_checkout_session, qashier_refund_payment · Public sink: qashier_create_checkout_session, qashier_expire_checkout_session, qashier_refund_payment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
